buffGear.title: Buff Gear
buffGear.description: Understand the Faction, Type, and Level slots, compare their stat pools, and follow each progression system without inventing unverified formulas.

overview.title: One character, three gear types
overview.intro: Each type checks a separate compatibility condition and has a different stat pool.
overview.compatibilityNote: A character can only equip Buff Gear matching their Faction, Type, and Level/Class.

faction.name: Faction Buff Gear
faction.description: Matches the character's Faction; confirmed example: Hero.
faction.focus: Leans toward speed, critical hits, and controlling attack tempo.

type.name: Type Buff Gear
type.description: Matches the combat Type; confirmed example: Hi-Tech.
type.focus: Leans toward blocking, effects, and defensive or utility choices.

level.name: Level Buff Gear
level.focus: Leans toward skill damage, bonus damage, and damage reduction.

main.title: Main Stat
main.description: Each gear starts with one Main Stat. Ascension focuses on increasing it.

bonus.title: Bonus Stats
bonus.description: Starts with zero or one line; Transformation can raise the total to five.

skill.title: Skill Stat
skill.description: Rare and Excellent gear can have a chance to grant one Skill Stat; the chance is unknown.

example.title: Three HP Buff 5% lines
example.warning: The source only confirms one HP Buff 5% line on each gear. It does not prove the final HP formula is +15%.

assets.title: Source image library
assets.description: Images load only when opened. They are not mapped to gear types because filenames do not prove their meaning.

comparison.title: Stat pools by gear type
comparison.intro: Hover stat names for tooltips. Purification ranges show explicit min–max values.
comparison.analysisNote: Role hints based on stat pools are analysis only: Faction leans speed/crit, Type leans utility/defense, and Level leans damage/reduction. This is not mandatory meta.
comparison.fullPoolHint: Open this only when you need every Transformation, Purification, and Refine entry.

progression.title: Five systems with distinct goals
progression.intro: Select a step to inspect its rules. Transformation is not Ascension, and Purification is not Refine.
progression.unknownLimit: The overall Purification limit is not shown by the source; 12 must not be presented as the maximum.

transformation.name: Transformation
transformation.description: Changes values or grants a new Bonus Stat type. Reset returns Bonus Stats to their initial state.

ascension.name: Ascension
ascension.description: Greatly increases the Main Stat, unlike Transformation which handles Bonus Stats.

advance.name: Advance
advance.description: Orange gear becomes Red Drop Buff, inherits Transformation and Ascension, then gains a random Refinement Attribute.

purification.name: Purification
purification.description: Unlocks effects or a skill at milestones; unlocked effects and bonuses can reroll under lock rules.

refine.name: Refine
refine.description: Requires Ascension. Secondary effects change randomly while the original effect's refinement magnitude is retained.

rules.grantNewBonusType: May grant a new Bonus Stat type.
rules.resetToInitial: Reset returns Bonus Stats to their initial state.
rules.lockMaximumTwo: Up to two Bonus Stats can be locked per gear.
rules.rerollUnlockedBonus: Unlocked bonus stats can reroll randomly.
rules.lockedEffectRetainsEffect: A locked effect stays while its bonus stat rerolls.
rules.lockedSkillRetainsSkill: A locked skill stays after Purification.
rules.sameKindTransfer: Same-kind Red Drop Buffs can transfer effects and skills.
rules.retainOriginalMagnitude: Retains the original effect's refinement magnitude.

skills.title: 22 Skill Stat glossary
skills.intro: Search in Vietnamese or English, then filter by a beginner-friendly role.

notes.title: Data notes
notes.formulas: Do not infer stacking formulas, roll rates, or material costs.
notes.partial: Cropped descriptions, such as Burning Boost, are marked as partial source.
notes.server: Names and translations may vary by server.

guide.characterHint: Each slot checks a different compatibility condition.
guide.anatomyIntro: Main is the foundation, Bonus lines grow over time, and Skill is a conditional special effect.
guide.orangeHint: The first three systems progress independently on Orange gear.
guide.independentBranches: After Advance, Purification and Refine are two independent branches.
guide.systemDetailsTitle: Each system has one primary goal
